title: Exploring the Personality Traits of LLMs through Latent Features Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying bias by measuring the direct logit difference of contrastive word pairs (e.g., female vs. male) in a sentence completion task before and after feature steering.
Quantifying bias by measuring the direct logit difference of contrastive word pairs related to age (e.g., young vs. older) in a sentence completion task before and after feature steering.

Quantifying bias by measuring the direct logit difference of contrastive word pairs representing socioeconomic status (e.g., rich vs. poor) in a sentence completion task before and after feature steering.
